$comment: JSON Schema (not FlatBuffers) of the <file>.ovt-raw.json sidecar of a headerless raw YUV file; chapter 08 section 8.6.6, WI-1.229. Unknown keys are ignored by the reader so later versions can add some.
title: OVT raw YUV sidecar

pix_fmt.description: FFmpeg pixel-format name from the grammar of chapter 08 section 8.6.6.

fps.description: Frame rate: "num/den" or a number. Defaults to 25/1.

header_bytes.description: Bytes to skip before the first frame.

color.description: H.273 code points of the pictures; absent means unspecified (2).
